translation: The Clear Quran — Dr. Mustafa Khattab

verses.78:1: What are they asking one another about
verses.78:4: But no! They will come to know
verses.78:5: Again, no! They will come to know
verses.78:6: Have We not smoothed out the earth ˹like a bed˺
verses.78:9: and made your sleep for rest
verses.78:10: and made the night as a cover
verses.78:11: and made the day for livelihood
verses.78:12: and built above you seven mighty ˹heavens˺
verses.78:13: and placed ˹in them˺ a shining lamp
verses.78:14: and sent down from rainclouds pouring water
verses.78:15: producing by it grain and ˹various˺ plants
verses.78:17: Indeed, the Day of ˹Final˺ Decision is an appointed time—
verses.78:18: ˹it is˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and you will ˹all˺ come forth in crowds
verses.78:19: The sky will be ˹split˺ open, becoming ˹many˺ gates
verses.78:20: and the mountains will be blown away, becoming ˹like˺ a mirage
verses.78:21: Indeed, Hell is lying in ambush
verses.78:22: as a home for the transgressors
verses.78:23: where they will remain for ˹endless˺ ages
verses.78:24: There they will not taste any coolness or drink
verses.78:27: For they never expected any reckoning
verses.78:29: And We have everything recorded precisely
verses.78:30: ˹So the deniers will be told,˺ “Taste ˹the punishment˺, for all you will get from Us is more torment.”
verses.78:31: Indeed, the righteous will have salvation—
verses.78:33: and full-bosomed maidens of equal age
verses.78:35: never to hear any idle talk or lying therein—
verses.78:36: a ˹fitting˺ reward as a generous gift from your Lord
verses.78:37: the Lord of the heavens and the earth and everything in between, the Most Compassionate. No one will dare speak to Him
verses.78:38: on the Day the ˹holy˺ spirit and the angels will stand in ranks. None will talk, except those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are true
verses.78:39: That Day is the ˹ultimate˺ truth. So let whoever wills take the path leading back to their Lord
verses.78:40: Indeed, We have warned you of an imminent punishment—the Day every person will see ˹the consequences of˺ what their hands have done, and the disbelievers will cry, “I wish I were dust.”
